PZZ700-222200-
145 AM PDT Thu Oct 22 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1008 mb low was over the northern Gulf of California
and a 1012 mb low was 300 nautical miles west of Punta Colonet,
Mexico, and a 1024 mb high was 800 nautical miles west of San 
Diego. A storm system will slowly move through the coastal waters 
today through Friday. There is a slight chance of thunderstorms 
today. Any thunderstorm is capable of producing gusty, erratic 
winds, choppy seas, lightning, briefly heavy rainfall with reduced
visibility, and waterspouts. Isolated northwest wind gusts will 
occasionally exceed 20 knots Friday. Weak offshore flow during the
nights and mornings will alternate with onshore northwest flow 
during the afternoons and evenings Friday night through Monday.

$$
